items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: when Miles and Coltrane were coming through at the same time. Everybody’s attention kind of went that way.

ctx.x: It is. And I don’t want to spout it or anything but all these guys were part of musical history, for jazz history, which I don’t know, is kind of — it seems to be not ignored, but not as many people know about that part of jazz as when Miles and Coltrane were coming through at the same time. Everybody’s attention kind of went that way.
Yeah. As if that’s where things really started.
